messages:
customer-jones: Hi team — after upgrading to @redwood/sdk v0.21.0 our Node service started getting 404s from the API and some requests return a 422 "missing required param: model". This started after we bumped the package and redeployed yesterday night. Repro: simple embeddings call via the SDK.

support-alex: Sorry about that — can you paste the minimal repro (code + npm ls output) and the raw response body you saw?

customer-jones: Repro below. We only upgraded the SDK, nothing else changed.
```js
// index.js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.embeddings({ model: 'text-embed-001', input: 'test' });
```

npm ls @redwood/sdk
```
project@1.0.0 /srv/app
└─┬ @redwood/sdk@0.21.0
  └── (empty)
```
Raw response (curl of SDK underlying request):
```
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "endpoint /v1/responses not found" }
```
And occasionally: `HTTP 422 {"error":"missing required param: model"}`

support-alex: Thanks. Two quick checks: what's the API URL you are pointing at (host header)? and can you share package-lock or yarn.lock? Also did you have any proxy in front?

customer-jones: Using REDWOOD_API_BASE=https://api.redwood-inference.com (hosted). No custom proxy. Lockfile: yarn.lock attached (omitted here).

support-alex: Looking at this it smells like a client/server mismatch. v0.21.0 of the SDK started using the new Responses API path `/v1/responses` and renamed the `model` param to `modelId` in the JSON payload for consistency. If your tenant's control plane is still on the older compatibility shim (or the routing rule for responses -> completions isn't enabled), requests can 404 or the backend expects `model` and returns 422.

devx-ryan: Confirming — we shipped the SDK change in 0.21.0 to align with the new Responses surface. There was an incremental deployment for control plane routing last week; some tenants may not have picked up the new route mapping and will see 404s when the SDK targets `/v1/responses`.

support-alex: For an immediate workaround you can either:
- Pin the SDK to the last compatible version: `npm install @redwood/sdk@0.20.3` and redeploy.
- Or use the REST fallback and call the legacy endpoint directly (example):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-001","input":"test"}'
```
- If you must stay on 0.21.0, you can monkeypatch the outgoing request until we fix the routing: set `REDWOOD_SDK_LEGACY_COMPAT=true` in env as a temporary toggle (server-side feature gate we enabled for some customers).

customer-jones: Pinning to 0.20.3 fixed our immediate 404s. Thanks. Curious what the correct long-term path is — should we update to the new API shape or wait?

devx-ryan: Long term we recommend migrating to the Responses API shape (modelId + /v1/responses) — it unifies streaming, function calls, and structured outputs. But we should not force a breaking change. We're doing two things:
1) infra-chen is coordinating a control-plane rollout to ensure all tenants have the route mapping.
2) we'll ship SDK 0.21.1 within the next 2 business days to add a small compatibility shim so 0.21.0 will fall back to `/v1/completions` and accept `model` when the server hasn't flipped.

infra-chen: Started a rollout for the legacy route mapping now. I'll post here with progress and tenant list.

support-bot: deploybot: infra update started at 2026-03-17T14:12:03Z — rolling config to edge routers (10 clusters).

devx-ryan: Action items for us:
- (dev) cut 0.21.1 with a transparent shim + tests (in progress).
- (infra) finish rollout and verify no 404s for customers on 0.21.0.
- (support) notify affected customers and recommend pinning or using the env toggle.

customer-jones: Appreciate the fast turnaround. One note: our CI uses `npm ci` with package-lock, so we'll keep pinned until upstream confirms. Please ping when 0.21.1 is out.

support-alex: Will do — follow-up: can you collect an example failing request payload (from your app logs) and paste it if you still see 422 after the shim? That'll help us verify validation mismatch.

customer-jones: Will do. For now 0.20.3 works. Thank you! :white_check_mark:

devx-ryan: ETA for 0.21.1 patch: ~36 hours. We'll post the release notes and compatibility instructions in #eng-releases and update the SDK changelog.

infra-chen: Rollout status: 6/10 clusters done, no errors so far. Will update in 15m.

support-bot: deploybot: infra update progress: 6/10 clusters, estimated 12 minutes remaining.

support-alex: Marking this thread as monitored — will close after 0.21.1 release and confirmation from customer.
